- [ ] `High` **Image loading HTTP client (Coil)** — KMP Android image OkHttpClient is bare: no shared cache, timeouts, ping/retry, or wasabisys hostname verifier ➗
- [ ] `Medium` **HTTP client / offline cache** — offlineCacheInterceptor (offline only-if-cached + 7-day maxStale) not ported at all
- [ ] `Medium` **HTTP client / timeouts** — KMP adds a 60s whole-request timeout that native never had; native's read/write semantics differ from Ktor's socket timeout
- [ ] `Medium` **HTTP client / logging** — KMP logs HTTP on every build at HEADERS level; native logs only in DEBUG at BODY level
- [ ] `Low` **HTTP client / connection keepalive & retry (non-Android)** — retryOnConnectionFailure + 15s pingInterval applied only on Android; iOS/Desktop omit them
- [ ] `Low` **HTTP client / JSON configuration** — KMP installs kotlinx ContentNegotiation JSON with lenient settings; native Retrofit uses ScalarsConverterFactory (raw String only)
- [ ] `Low` **HTTP client / default browser headers (installBrowserHeaders)** — installBrowserHeaders extension is dead code in KMP (never called); this matches native where BrowserHeadersInterceptor is also unused
- [ ] `Low` **HTTP client / engine fan-out (Retrofit vs Ktor)** — Retrofit+single OkHttpClient replaced by 3 Ktor engines (OkHttp/Darwin/CIO) with no shared config extraction
- [ ] `Low` **HTTP client / endpoint surface (ApiClient vs IMangaDataApiServices)** — ApiClient exposes 9 methods vs native's 17 Retrofit methods; the convenience FormUrlEncoded helpers (searchManga/searchMangaWithOrder/loadMore/normalPost) are collapsed into generic postForm/postJson

#### Source Repositories Parity
- [ ] `High` **Source registry - Italian MangaPark (Mangapark-It)** — Italian MangaPark source active in native, completely missing (unported stub) in KMP ✅
- [ ] `Medium` **Source registry - DI binding mechanism** — Native uses Hilt Binds IntoSet multibinding; KMP uses a hand-maintained Koin setOf list
- [ ] `Low` **Source registry - orphaned MANGAPARK_IT enum entry** — KMP keeps MANGAPARK_IT enum entry with no repository backing it
- [ ] `Low` **Enabled/disabled sets - Comick and ReadComicOnline** — Disabled-source set is parity-equal between the two apps

#### DI / Startup / Lifecycle
- [ ] `Critical` **Startup — Remote source-list seeding (initializeSources)** — Native fetches and seeds/updates the manga source list from a remote endpoint at startup; KMP has no equivalent and the responsible class was retired ✅
- [ ] `High` **Startup — UMP consent gathering before ads** — Native runs the full Google UMP consent flow at startup before initializing ads; KMP never invokes consent ✅
- [ ] `High` **Startup — In-app review prompt** — Native launches Play in-app review at startup; KMP never triggers it ➗
- [ ] `High` **Startup — In-app update check (Play Core)** — Native checks for and starts a flexible in-app update at startup; KMP only constructs the update manager and never checks ✅
- [ ] `High` **Notifications — FCM message handling (MyFirebaseMessagingService)** — Native's FCM service displays incoming push notifications and handles token refresh; KMP's service is an empty stub ✅
- [ ] `Medium` **Startup — MobileAds initialization (consent gating)** — Native defers/gates ad init on consent; KMP initializes MobileAds unconditionally and eagerly
- [ ] `Medium` **Startup — In-app update progress listener** — Native registers a flexible-update progress/downloaded listener at startup; KMP has no such listener
- [ ] `Medium` **Lifecycle — Activity.onResume update resume** — Native resumes a pending flexible update in onResume; KMP MainActivity has no onResume
- [ ] `Medium` **Startup — FirebaseAnalytics APP_OPEN event** — Native logs an APP_OPEN analytics event on each launch; KMP logs nothing at startup
- [ ] `Medium` **Startup — Uncaught exception / crash handler** — KMP actively installs a global uncaught-exception handler that records to Crashlytics and launches CrashActivity; native leaves this code commented out (inactive)
- [ ] `Low` **Lifecycle — Activity.onActivityResult (update flow result)** — Native handles the in-app update flow result (RESULT_OK/CANCELED/failure) in onActivityResult; KMP has no handler
- [ ] `Low` **Lifecycle — Activity.onDestroy cleanup** — Native cancels its review scope and unregisters the update listener in onDestroy; KMP has no onDestroy
- [ ] `Low` **Startup — testing-mode ApiTestScreen branch at app root** — Native conditionally renders an admin ApiTestScreen at the app root when Admin.testingMode; KMP always renders MainScreen
- [ ] `Low` **Startup — edge-to-edge / decor-fits-system-windows ordering** — Native calls WindowCompat.setDecorFitsSystemWindows(window,false) AFTER super.onCreate; KMP calls enableEdgeToEdge() BEFORE super.onCreate
- [ ] `Low` **WorkManager — Configuration.Provider setup** — Native sets the worker factory directly in the WorkManager Configuration; KMP sets only a logging level and relies on Koin's workManagerFactory()
- [ ] `Low` **Startup — onCreate initialization order (MyApp)** — The sequence of startup initializers differs between native and KMP
- [ ] `Low` **DI graph — Koin vs Hilt coverage of core singletons** — Network stack and provider bindings were re-platformed from Hilt (OkHttp/Retrofit) to Koin (Ktor); coverage is otherwise comparable
